body.name: Constant-\(X\) finite-feature inverse handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathfrak I_0\): when \(X\) is degenerate, augment the \(K\times K\times K\) feature tensor \(T_u=E\{h_{0,u}(Y)e_Ae_Z^{\mathsf T}\}\) by the observed normalization slice \(S=P(A,Z)\), differentiate \((S,T_1,\ldots,T_K)\), and invert its separated finite Jacobian on the observed score image to recover centered scores for \(\pi\), \(M_A\), \(M_Z\), and \(\Gamma_Y\).
